newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Leo Shield to raise exploration funds.
newsitem.headline: Leo Shield to raise exploration funds.

text.p: Mineral explorer Leo Shield Exploration NL said on Thursday it plans to issue up to 6.5 million shares to raise up to $2.925 million for gold exploration in West Africa.
The shares would be placed with institutional clients of HSBC James Capel Australia Ltd and SBC Warburg Australia Ltd at an issue price of 45 cents per share, the company said.
Leo Shield director Colin Carson said the funds would be used to progress exploration in existing projects.
Leo Shield is involved in about 30 mineral concessions in West Africa, about 20 of which are in Ghana.
